newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London sink on Premier rumour.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London sink on Premier rumour.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London sank on Thursday as rumours that Chinese Premier Deng Xiaoping was unwell sent jitters through the market, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was some 55 points lower at 131,184.5 by 1630 GMT. In Hong Kong overnight, the Hang Seng tumbled sharply on the rumours to close 222.66 points lower at 13,239.95.
"There hasn't been much selling pressure in Hong Kong stocks other than the HSBC," one trader said, adding that the Hang Seng was expected to open lower on Friday.
"People are talking of the market coming down to the 13,000 level."
